text:
Continued Consolidation Called For Taiwan Bourse November 20, 2018, 07:30: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had advanced more than 50 points or 0.5 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now rests just shy of the 9,745-point plateau and it's looking at another soft start again TSE finished modestly lower on Tuesday following losses from the technology stocks and the financial shares.
 lost 84.70 points or 0.86 percent to finish at 9,743.99 after trading between 9,726.80 and 9,800.00 on turnover of 92.15 billion Taiwan dollars.
Among the actives, Cathay Financial retreated 1.57 percent, while Fubon Financial tumbled 1.94 percent, CTBC Financial skidded 1.64 percent, Mega Financial lost 0.75 percent, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company dropped 1.80 percent, Largan Precision spiked 2.49 percent, Hon Hai Precision plunged 3.27 percent, United Microelectronics Corporation was down 0.90 percent, AU Optronics plummeted 2.75 percent, Catcher Technology shed 0.57 percent, Asia Cement slid 1.19 percent, Taiwan Cement gained 0.41 percent, Formosa Plastic declined 1.47 percent, Chunghwa Telecom added 0.47 percent and AsusTek Computer was unchanged.
